$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
P='terminal/tasks/fishFry/rim_arc_radial_measurements_20261109/measure_rim.py'
CSV='terminal/tasks/fishFry/rim_arc_radial_measurements_20261109/rim_measurements.csv'
JSON='terminal/tasks/fishFry/rim_arc_radial_measurements_20261109/rim_measurements.json'
test -f "$P" && test -f "$CSV" && test -f "$JSON"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import csv,json,math
p=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/rim_arc_radial_measurements_20261109/measure_rim.py')
s=p.read_text()
assert s.count('f"total_px={interval_px*8:.4f}"')==1
assert s.count('source unchanged, 9 radial measurements, 8 equal arc intervals, source and Sobel overlays, saved tables')==1
s=s.replace('f"total_px={interval_px*8:.4f}"','f"total_px={interval_px*(N-1):.4f}"')
s=s.replace('source unchanged, 9 radial measurements, 8 equal arc intervals, source and Sobel overlays, saved tables','source unchanged, 5 radial measurements, 4 equal arc intervals, source and Sobel overlays, saved tables')
assert 'N=5' in s
p.write_text(s)
with Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/rim_arc_radial_measurements_20261109/rim_measurements.csv').open(newline='') as f: rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
data=json.loads(Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/rim_arc_radial_measurements_20261109/rim_measurements.json').read_text())
assert len(rows)==5 and data['equal_arc_sampling']['number_points']==5
assert data['equal_arc_sampling']['number_equal_intervals']==4
n=data['equal_arc_sampling']['interval_px']
assert math.isclose(data['equal_arc_sampling']['arc_first_to_last_px'],4*n,rel_tol=1e-12)
assert math.isclose(float(rows[-1]['arc_distance_from_first_px']),4*n,abs_tol=.0001)
assert math.isclose(data['equal_arc_sampling']['interval_inches_est'],1.85984,abs_tol=0.0001)
print('VALIDATED_FIVE_RADII_FOUR_EQUAL_ARCS')
print('TOTAL_ARC_PX',round(4*n,4))
print('INTERVAL_PX',round(n,4))
print('NUM_RIM_POINTS',len(rows))
PY
git add -- "$P"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 1
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Correct rim measurement script reporting to five points and four arc intervals'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6;do
 git fetch --quiet origin main
 git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
 if git push origin HEAD:main;then
  printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
  printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
  L=$(git hash-object "$P")
  R=$(gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$P" --jq .sha)
  test "$L" = "$R"
  printf 'VERIFIED_SCRIPT_REMOTE_BLOB %s\n' "$R"
  exit 0
 fi
done
echo PUBLICATION_FAILED >&2
exit 1
